note: One engraved page and the staff position of each of its elements.
Read by two test suites that cannot link to each other: clausters-core's
notation::svg (DisplayList::staff_position) and the GUI host's own
ScoreData::staff_position, in the separate clients/gui workspace. The host
measures a pitch out of a display list it was sent and the client resolves
the position it names against the same drawing, so the two readings have
to agree exactly or a pitch edit lands somewhere nobody asked for.
The geometry is deliberately awkward: a short system on a wide sheet (the
case that broke the first rule, which measured a staff line against the
viewBox instead of against the page's other horizontal strokes), a second
system far below, a ledger line and a beam to be told apart from staff
lines, and a notehead engraved off the staff.
